## Import

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(easystats)
library(broom)
library(glue)
library(plotgardener)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
setwd("~/gitcode/DNAm")
`%nin%` = negate(`%in%`) 
```

## Munge

### Endophenotypes

```{r}
merge.raw <- read_csv("resources/ADNI/ADNIMERGE_25Sep2023.csv")
cog.raw <- read_csv("resources/ADNI/ADSP-PHC/Assessment_Analyses/ADSP_ADNI_Cognition_Dec2023/ADSP_PHC_COGN_Dec2023.csv")
fluid_bm.raw <- read_csv("resources/ADNI/ADSP-PHC/Biospecimen_Analyses/ADSP_PHC_CSF_Dec2023.csv")

dx_bl <- filter(cog.raw, PHC_Visit == 1) %>% 
    mutate(
    dx_bl = case_when(
      PHC_Diagnosis == "1" ~ "CN", 
      PHC_Diagnosis == "2" ~ "MCI", 
      PHC_Diagnosis == "3" ~ "AD", 
     ), 
    dx_bl = fct_relevel(dx_bl, "CN", "MCI", "AD"), 
  ) %>%
    select(RID, dx_bl)


```

### Methylation

```{r}
## Mythylation
map.raw <- readxl::read_xlsx("resources/ADNI/ADNI_DNA_Methylation_SampleAnnotation_20170530.xlsx") %>%
  mutate(Edate = as.Date(Edate))
clocks.raw <- read_csv("intermediate/adni_epiclocks_240826.csv") %>%
  rename(barcodes = '...1' ) 
deconv6.raw <- read_csv("intermediate/DeconvoluteBloodEPIC_results.csv") %>%
  rename(barcodes = '...1' ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -barcodes, names_to = "Sample", values_to = "Value") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = barcodes, values_from = Value)
deconv12.raw <- read_csv("intermediate/TwelveCellDeconvoluteBloodEPIC_results.csv") %>%
  rename(barcodes = '...1' ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -barcodes, names_to = "Sample", values_to = "Value") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = barcodes, values_from = Value)

dnam.raw <- map.raw %>%
  dplyr::select(barcodes, RID, Phase,  Edate, DateDrawn, PlateNumber, Array) %>%
  rename(Phase_methy = Phase,  Edate_methy = Edate, DateDrawn_methy = DateDrawn) %>%
  arrange(RID, Edate_methy, PlateNumber) %>%
  left_join(clocks.raw, by = 'barcodes') %>%
  left_join(deconv6.raw, by = c('barcodes' = 'Sample')) %>%
  # left_join(deconv12.raw, by = c('barcodes' = 'Sample')) %>%
  left_join(select(cog.raw, RID, EXAMDATE, PHC_Age_Cognition, PHC_Sex, PHC_Diagnosis), by = c("RID", 'Edate_methy' = "EXAMDATE")) %>%
  relocate(RID, Edate_methy, PHC_Age_Cognition, PHC_Sex, PHC_Diagnosis) %>%
  select(-Age) %>%
  rename(Age = PHC_Age_Cognition, dx = PHC_Diagnosis, sex = PHC_Sex) %>%
  mutate(
      dx = case_when(
        dx == 1 ~ "CN",
        dx == 2 ~ "MCI",
        dx == 3 ~ "AD",
   ),
  )

dnam <- dnam.raw %>% 
  group_by(RID, Edate_methy) %>%
  distinct(RID, .keep_all = T) %>%
  group_by(RID) %>%
  slice(1:3)%>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-Age)

```

### Telomeres
- TL_BP_ADJ: Telomere length / Single copy gene (T/S) ratio of DNA from blood, adjusted for logistical confounders

```{r}
## Telomere Ration
ts.raw <- read_csv("resources/ADNI/TS_RATIO_ADJ_23Aug2024.csv")

ts <- ts.raw %>% 
  arrange(RID, EXAM_DATE) %>%
  group_by(RID, EXAM_DATE) %>%
  distinct(RID, .keep_all = T) %>%
  group_by(RID) %>%
  slice(1:3) %>%
  ungroup() 
  
```

### APOE

```{r}
## APOE 
apoe.raw <- read_csv('resources/ADNI/APOERES_15Nov2023.csv')
apoe <- apoe.raw %>%
  unite(apoe_geno, c(APGEN1, APGEN2), sep = "") %>%
  mutate(
    apoe = case_when(
      apoe_geno == "22" ~ "e2+", 
      apoe_geno == "23" ~ "e2+", 
      apoe_geno == "24" ~ "e4+", 
      apoe_geno == "33" ~ "e3/e3", 
      apoe_geno == "34" ~ "e4+", 
      apoe_geno == "44" ~ "e4+", 
    ), 
    apoe = fct_relevel(apoe, "e3/e3"), 
  ) %>%
   fastDummies::dummy_cols(select_columns = "apoe", remove_most_frequent_dummy = T) %>%
  rename(apoe_e2 = `apoe_e2+`, apoe_e4 = `apoe_e4+`)
  
 
```

## Merge 
```{r}
## APOE 
tl.merge <- ts %>% select(RID, EXAM_DATE, TL_BP_ADJ)
dnam.merge <- dnam %>% select(
  RID, Edate_methy, 
  PhenoAge, Horvathv2, Hannum, Lin, DNAmGrimAgev2, AgeAccelGrimv2, CausAge,  DamAge, AdaptAge, DunedinPACE, 
  neutrophil, nk_cell, b_cell, cd4_t_cell, cd8_t_cell, monocyte, 
  # Bas, Bmem, Bnv, CD4mem, CD4nv, CD8mem, CD8nv, Eos, Mono, NK, Neu, Treg
  )
apoe.merge <- apoe %>% select(RID, apoe_geno, apoe, apoe_e2, apoe_e4)
cog.merge <- cog.raw %>% 
  # filter(RID %in% tl.merge$RID) %>%
  select(RID, VISCODE2, EXAMDATE, PHC_Visit, PHC_Sex, PHC_Education, PHC_Ethnicity, PHC_Race, PHC_Age_Cognition, PHC_Diagnosis, 
         PHC_MEM, PHC_EXF, PHC_LAN, PHC_VSP)
fbm.merge <- fluid_bm.raw %>% 
  arrange(RID, PHC_Visit) %>%
  select(RID, PHC_Visit, DRAWDATE, Platform, PHC_AB42, PHC_Tau, AT_class)
 
genetics <- tl.merge %>% 
  left_join(dnam.merge, by = c("RID", 'EXAM_DATE' = 'Edate_methy'))  %>% 
  left_join(apoe.merge, by = c("RID")) 

epi_age_acc <- cog.merge %>% 
  left_join(genetics, by = c("RID", 'EXAMDATE' = "EXAM_DATE")) %>%
  select(RID, PHC_Visit, EXAMDATE, PHC_Age_Cognition, 
        CausAge, DamAge, AdaptAge, PhenoAge, Horvathv2, Hannum, Lin, DNAmGrimAgev2, 
        neutrophil, nk_cell, b_cell, cd4_t_cell, cd8_t_cell, monocyte
        # Bas, Bmem, Bnv, CD4mem, CD4nv, CD8mem, CD8nv, Eos, Mono, NK, Neu, Treg
        ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(CausAge)) %>%
  group_by(RID) %>%
  slice_min(EXAMDATE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate()

raa_causage_mod <- lm(CausAge ~ PHC_Age_Cognition, data = epi_age_acc)
raa_phenoage_mod <- lm(PhenoAge ~ PHC_Age_Cognition, data = epi_age_acc)
raa_horvath_mod <- lm(Horvathv2 ~ PHC_Age_Cognition, data = epi_age_acc)
raa_hannum_mod <- lm(Hannum ~ PHC_Age_Cognition, data = epi_age_acc)
raa_lin_mod <- lm(Lin ~ PHC_Age_Cognition, data = epi_age_acc)
raa_grimage_mod <- lm(DNAmGrimAgev2 ~ PHC_Age_Cognition, data = epi_age_acc)

iraa_causage_mod <- lm(CausAge ~ PHC_Age_Cognition + neutrophil + nk_cell + b_cell + cd4_t_cell + cd8_t_cell, data = epi_age_acc)
iraa_phenoage_mod <- lm(PhenoAge ~ PHC_Age_Cognition + neutrophil + nk_cell + b_cell + cd4_t_cell + cd8_t_cell, data = epi_age_acc)
iraa_horvath_mod <- lm(Horvathv2 ~ PHC_Age_Cognition + neutrophil + nk_cell + b_cell + cd4_t_cell + cd8_t_cell, data = epi_age_acc)
iraa_hannum_mod <- lm(Hannum ~ PHC_Age_Cognition + neutrophil + nk_cell + b_cell + cd4_t_cell + cd8_t_cell, data = epi_age_acc)
iraa_lin_mod <- lm(Lin ~ PHC_Age_Cognition + neutrophil + nk_cell + b_cell + cd4_t_cell + cd8_t_cell, data = epi_age_acc)
iraa_grimage_mod <- lm(DNAmGrimAgev2 ~ PHC_Age_Cognition + neutrophil + nk_cell + b_cell + cd4_t_cell + cd8_t_cell, data = epi_age_acc)

# iraa_causage_mod <- lm(CausAge ~ PHC_Age_Cognition +  Bas + Bmem + Bnv + CD4mem + CD4nv + CD8mem + CD8nv + Eos + NK + Neu + Treg, 
#   data = epi_age_acc)
# iraa_phenoage_mod <- lm(PhenoAge ~ PHC_Age_Cognition +  Bas + Bmem + Bnv + CD4mem + CD4nv + CD8mem + CD8nv + Eos + NK + Neu + Treg, 
#   data = epi_age_acc)
# iraa_horvath_mod <- lm(Horvathv2 ~ PHC_Age_Cognition +  Bas + Bmem + Bnv + CD4mem + CD4nv + CD8mem + CD8nv + Eos + NK + Neu + Treg, 
#   data = epi_age_acc)
# iraa_hannum_mod <- lm(Hannum ~ PHC_Age_Cognition +  Bas + Bmem + Bnv + CD4mem + CD4nv + CD8mem + CD8nv + Eos + NK + Neu + Treg, 
#   data = epi_age_acc)
# iraa_lin_mod <- lm(Lin ~ PHC_Age_Cognition +  Bas + Bmem + Bnv + CD4mem + CD4nv + CD8mem + CD8nv + Eos + NK + Neu + Treg, 
#   data = epi_age_acc)
# iraa_grimage_mod <- lm(DNAmGrimAgev2 ~ PHC_Age_Cognition +  Bas + Bmem + Bnv + CD4mem + CD4nv + CD8mem + CD8nv + Eos + NK + Neu + Treg, 
#   data = epi_age_acc)

raa_mod <- list(
  CausAge = raa_causage_mod, 
  PhenoAge = raa_phenoage_mod, 
  Horvathv2 = raa_horvath_mod, 
  Hannum = raa_hannum_mod, 
  Lin = raa_lin_mod, 
  DNAmGrimAgev2 = raa_grimage_mod
  ) %>%
  map_df(tidy, .id = "test") %>%
    mutate(
    term = case_when(
      term == "(Intercept)" ~ "Intercept",
      term == "PHC_Age_Cognition" ~ "Slope",
      TRUE ~ term  # Keep other terms unchanged
    ))


epi_age_acc$causage_raa_bl <- residuals(raa_causage_mod)
epi_age_acc$phenoage_raa_bl <- residuals(raa_phenoage_mod)
epi_age_acc$horvath_raa_bl <- residuals(raa_horvath_mod)
epi_age_acc$hannum_raa_bl <- residuals(raa_hannum_mod)
epi_age_acc$lin_raa_bl <- residuals(raa_lin_mod)
epi_age_acc$grimage_raa_bl <- residuals(raa_grimage_mod)

epi_age_acc$causage_iraa_bl <- residuals(iraa_causage_mod)
epi_age_acc$phenoage_iraa_bl <- residuals(iraa_phenoage_mod)
epi_age_acc$horvath_iraa_bl <- residuals(iraa_horvath_mod)
epi_age_acc$hannum_iraa_bl <- residuals(iraa_hannum_mod)
epi_age_acc$lin_iraa_bl <- residuals(iraa_lin_mod)
epi_age_acc$grimage_iraa_bl <- residuals(iraa_grimage_mod)

## Might need to filter this to omics bl
mean_age <- filter(cog.merge, PHC_Visit == 1) %>% summarise(age = mean(PHC_Age_Cognition, na.rm = T)) %>% pull(age)

adni <- cog.merge %>%
  left_join(select(merge.raw, RID, EXAMDATE, ORIGPROT, CDRSB), by = c("RID", 'EXAMDATE')) %>%
  left_join(fbm.merge, by = c('RID', 'PHC_Visit')) %>%
  # left_join(dx_bl, by = c("RID")) %>%
  # left_join(genetics_bl, by = c("RID")) %>%
  left_join(genetics, by = c("RID", 'EXAMDATE' = "EXAM_DATE")) %>%
  left_join(select(epi_age_acc, RID, EXAMDATE, contains('raa')), by = c("RID", 'EXAMDATE')) %>%
  mutate(
    age_c = PHC_Age_Cognition - mean_age, 
    sex = ifelse(PHC_Sex == 1, "Male", "Female")
  ) %>%
  group_by(RID) %>%
  filter(any(!is.na(TL_BP_ADJ))) %>%
  filter(any(!is.na(CausAge))) %>%
  mutate(
    tl_bl = case_when(
      PHC_Visit == min(PHC_Visit[!is.na(TL_BP_ADJ)]) ~ TL_BP_ADJ
      ),
    causage_bl = case_when(
      PHC_Visit == min(PHC_Visit[!is.na(CausAge)]) ~ CausAge
      ),
    adptage_bl = case_when(
      PHC_Visit == min(PHC_Visit[!is.na(AdaptAge)]) ~ AdaptAge
      ),
    damage_bl = case_when(
      PHC_Visit == min(PHC_Visit[!is.na(DamAge)]) ~ DamAge
      ),
    phenoage_bl = case_when(
      PHC_Visit == min(PHC_Visit[!is.na(PhenoAge)]) ~ PhenoAge
      ),
    horvath_bl = case_when(
      PHC_Visit == min(PHC_Visit[!is.na(Horvathv2)]) ~ Horvathv2
      ),
    hannum_bl = case_when(
      PHC_Visit == min(PHC_Visit[!is.na(Hannum)]) ~ Hannum
      ),
    lin_bl = case_when(
      PHC_Visit == min(PHC_Visit[!is.na(Lin)]) ~ Lin
      ),
    grimage_bl = case_when(
      PHC_Visit == min(PHC_Visit[!is.na(DNAmGrimAgev2)]) ~ DNAmGrimAgev2
      ),
    ageaccelgrim_bl = case_when(
      PHC_Visit == min(PHC_Visit[!is.na(AgeAccelGrimv2)]) ~ AgeAccelGrimv2
      ),
    dunedinpace_bl = case_when(
      PHC_Visit == min(PHC_Visit[!is.na(DunedinPACE)]) ~ DunedinPACE
      ),
    causeage_aaa = CausAge - PHC_Age_Cognition, 
    damage_aaa = DamAge - PHC_Age_Cognition, 
    adptage_aaa = AdaptAge - PHC_Age_Cognition, 
    phenoage_aaa = PhenoAge - PHC_Age_Cognition, 
    horvath_aaa = Horvathv2 - PHC_Age_Cognition, 
    hannum_aaa = Hannum - PHC_Age_Cognition, 
    lin_aaa = Lin - PHC_Age_Cognition, 
    grimage_aaa = DNAmGrimAgev2 - PHC_Age_Cognition, 
    causeage_aaa_bl = case_when(
      PHC_Visit == min(PHC_Visit[!is.na(causeage_aaa)]) ~ causeage_aaa
      ),
    adptage_aaa_bl = case_when(
      PHC_Visit == min(PHC_Visit[!is.na(adptage_aaa)]) ~ adptage_aaa
      ),
    damage_aaa_bl = case_when(
      PHC_Visit == min(PHC_Visit[!is.na(damage_aaa)]) ~ damage_aaa
      ),
    phenoage_aaa_bl = case_when(
      PHC_Visit == min(PHC_Visit[!is.na(phenoage_aaa)]) ~ phenoage_aaa
      ),
    horvath_aaa_bl = case_when(
      PHC_Visit == min(PHC_Visit[!is.na(horvath_aaa)]) ~ horvath_aaa
      ),
    hannum_aaa_bl = case_when(
      PHC_Visit == min(PHC_Visit[!is.na(hannum_aaa)]) ~ hannum_aaa
      ),
    lin_aaa_bl = case_when(
      PHC_Visit == min(PHC_Visit[!is.na(lin_aaa)]) ~ lin_aaa
      ),
    grimage_aaa_bl = case_when(
      PHC_Visit == min(PHC_Visit[!is.na(grimage_aaa)]) ~ grimage_aaa
      ),
    ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
   z_tl_bl = scale(tl_bl)[,1]
  ) %>%
  group_by(RID) %>%
  fill(tl_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(causage_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(adptage_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(damage_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(phenoage_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(horvath_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(hannum_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(lin_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(grimage_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(ageaccelgrim_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(dunedinpace_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(causeage_aaa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(phenoage_aaa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(horvath_aaa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(hannum_aaa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(lin_aaa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(grimage_aaa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(adptage_aaa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(damage_aaa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(causage_raa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(phenoage_raa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(horvath_raa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(hannum_raa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(lin_raa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(grimage_raa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(causage_iraa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(phenoage_iraa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(horvath_iraa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(hannum_iraa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(lin_iraa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(grimage_iraa_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(z_tl_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(apoe, .direction = "updown") %>%
  fill(apoe, .direction = "down") %>%
  filter(!is.na(apoe)) %>%
  # filter(!is.na(CausAge)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(causage_bl)) %>%
  ## Exclude participants with only 1 visit
  filter(n() > 1) %>%
  # Baseline Diagnosis
  group_by(RID) %>%
  mutate( # Months from baseline genetics visit
    baseline_date = min(EXAMDATE, na.rm = TRUE),  # Get earliest EXAMDATE per RID (baseline)
    months_since_bl = as.numeric(difftime(EXAMDATE, baseline_date, units = "days")) / 30.4375,  # Convert days to months
    age_bl = min(PHC_Age_Cognition, na.rm = TRUE),
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cdrsb_bl = case_when(
      PHC_Visit == min(PHC_Visit) ~ CDRSB
      ), 
    dx_bl = case_when(
      PHC_Visit == min(PHC_Visit) ~ PHC_Diagnosis
      ), 
    dx_bl = case_when(
     dx_bl == 1 ~ "CN",
     dx_bl == 2 ~ "MCI",
     dx_bl == 3 ~ "AD",
   ),
    dx_bl = fct_relevel(dx_bl, "CN", "MCI", "AD"), 
    ORIGPROT = fct_relevel(ORIGPROT, "ADNI1", "ADNI2", "ADNIGO")
  ) %>% 
  fill(dx_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(cdrsb_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  # filter(dx_bl != "AD") %>%
  # filter(dx_bl != "CN") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(
    educ = PHC_Education, 
    months = months_since_bl, 
    cohort = ORIGPROT
  ) %>%
  relocate(age_bl, .after = PHC_Age_Cognition) %>%
  relocate(months, .after = PHC_Visit) %>%
  relocate(cohort, .after = RID) %>% 
  relocate(cdrsb_bl, .after = CDRSB) %>%
  relocate(dx_bl, .after = PHC_Diagnosis) 


```

## Descriptives 

```{r}
## Baseline 
adni_d <- adni %>%
  group_by(RID) %>%
  summarise(
    PHC_Visit = first(PHC_Visit),
    n_visit = n(),
    cohort = first(cohort),
    age = first(PHC_Age_Cognition), 
    sex = first(sex),
    educ = first(educ),
    cdrsb = first(cdrsb_bl),
    dx = first(PHC_Diagnosis),
    TL = first(TL_BP_ADJ), 
    PhenoAge = first(PhenoAge), 
    Horvathv2 = first(Horvathv2), 
    Hannum = first(Hannum),     
    Lin = first(Lin), 
    CausAge = first(CausAge), 
    # AdaptAge = first(AdaptAge), 
    # DamAge = first(DamAge), 
    DNAmGrimAgev2 = first(DNAmGrimAgev2), 
    AgeAccelGrimv2 = first(AgeAccelGrimv2), 
    DunedinPACE = first(DunedinPACE), 
   # aaa = first(aaa), 
    # raa = first(raa_bl)
  ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    dx = case_when(
     dx == 1 ~ "CN",
     dx == 2 ~ "MCI",
     dx == 3 ~ "AD",
   ),
   dx = fct_relevel(dx, "CN", "MCI", "AD")
  )

describe_distribution(adni_d)

## GT-summary
adni_d %>% 
  select(-RID, -PHC_Visit) %>%
  gtsummary::tbl_summary(
    ., by = dx, 
    statistic = list(
      gtsummary::all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
      gtsummary::all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
  ) 


## Corelations 
### Corr-test
res_cor <- adni_d %>%
  select(age, TL, CausAge, PhenoAge, Horvathv2, Hannum, Lin, 
         DNAmGrimAgev2, AgeAccelGrimv2, DunedinPACE) %>%
  drop_na() %>% 
  correlation()

BioAge_corr.p <- summary(res_corr) %>% 
  plot() + 
    theme(
      base_size = 8,
      text = element_text(size = 8)
    )

ggsave("results/plots/bioag_corrplot.png", plot = BioAge_corr.p, width = 9, height = 4, units = 'in')

### Age vs DNAm
dnam.p <-  adni_d %>%
  select(age, dx, CausAge, PhenoAge, Horvathv2, Hannum, Lin, 
         DNAmGrimAgev2, AgeAccelGrimv2, DunedinPACE) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      PhenoAge, Horvathv2, Hannum, Lin, DNAmGrimAgev2, CausAge, 
      # Zhang_10, DunedinPoAm38, AgeAccelGrimv1, AgeAccelGrimv2
    ),
    names_to = 'clock', 
    values_to = 'DNAm'
  ) 
  
bioage_lm.p <- ggplot(dnam.p, aes(x = age, y = DNAm, color = dx)) + 
  facet_wrap(facets = vars(clock)) + 
  geom_point(size = 0.75) + 
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = 'blue', linetype = 2, size = 1) + 
  geom_smooth(method = 'lm', se = F, color = 'red', linetype = 2, linewidth = 1) + 
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  theme_bw() + 
  labs(
    x = "Chronological Age (Years)",
    y = "DNA Methylation Age",
    color = "Model Type",
    title = "Comparison of Age and Epigenetic Clocks",
    caption = "Blue: AAA (Fixed Slope = 1), Red: RAA (Linear Fit)"
  ) + 
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"), 
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
  )
bioage_lm.p 
ggsave("results/plots/bioage_lm.png", plot = bioage_lm.p, width = 9, height = 4, units = 'in')

ggplot(adni_d, aes(x = age, y = CausAge)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = 2, colour = 'blue') + 
  geom_smooth(method = 'lm', se = F, color = 'green', linetype = 2) + 
  geom_abline(intercept = 19.88, slope = 0.57, linetype = 2, colour = 'red')

## Longdurtional 

adni_long <- adni %>%
  select(RID, PHC_Visit, PHC_Age_Cognition, dx_bl, CausAge, PhenoAge, Horvathv2, Hannum, Lin, 
         DNAmGrimAgev2) %>%
  rename(Age = PHC_Age_Cognition, Visit = PHC_Visit) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(CausAge:DNAmGrimAgev2), 
               names_to = "BioAge", 
               values_to = "Value") %>%
  arrange(RID, BioAge, Age) %>%
  drop_na(Value)  %>%
  group_by(RID, BioAge) %>%
  mutate(visit = 1:n()) %>%
  ungroup() 

sampled_rids <- adni %>%
  distinct(RID) %>%  # Get unique RID values
  sample_n(50) %>%  # Randomly select a subset
  pull(RID)

bioage_long.p <- ggplot(
    #adni_long
    filter(adni_long, RID %in% sampled_rids), 
    aes(x = visit, y = Value, group = RID, color = as.factor(dx_bl))
    ) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.75) +  # Add lines for individual trajectories
  # geom_point(size = 1) +    # Add points for observations
  facet_wrap(~BioAge) +  # Separate plots for each measure
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 3, by = 1)) + 
  labs(
    title = "Longitudinal Trajectories of Bioage Measures",
    x = "Visit",
    y = "Bioage Value",
    color = "Participant ID"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

bioage_long.p <- ggplot(
    #adni_long
    filter(adni_long, RID %in% sampled_rids), 
    aes(x = Age, y = Value, group = RID, color = as.factor(dx_bl))
    ) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.75) +  # Add lines for individual trajectories
  # geom_point(size = 1) +    # Add points for observations
  facet_wrap(~BioAge) +  # Separate plots for each measure
  labs(
    title = "Longitudinal Trajectories of Bioage Measures",
    x = "Chronological Age",
    y = "Bioage Value",
    color = "Participant ID"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

bioage_long.p

ggsave("results/plots/bioage_long.png", plot = bioage_long.p, width = 9, height = 4, units = 'in')

```


## Analysis
```{r}

library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)

fitlmer.00 <- lmer(PHC_MEM ~ age_c + (age_c  | RID), REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.00)

fitlmer.01 <- lmer(PHC_MEM ~ months + age_bl + sex + educ + apoe + dx_bl + neutrophil + nk_cell + b_cell + cd4_t_cell + cd8_t_cell + (age_c  | RID), REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.01)

fitlmer.02a <- lmer(PHC_MEM ~ months + age_bl + sex + educ + dx_bl + apoe + z_tl_bl + (months  | RID), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.02a)

fitlmer.02b <- lmer(PHC_MEM ~ months + age_bl + sex + educ + dx_bl + apoe + causage_bl + (months  | RID), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.02b)

## Longitudional
fitlmer.03a <- lmer(PHC_MEM ~ months + age_bl + sex + educ + cdrsb_bl + apoe*months + z_tl_bl*months + (months  | RID), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.03a)
plot_model(fitlmer.03a, type = "pred", terms = c("age_c", "z_tl_bl"))

fitlmer.03b <- lmer(PHC_MEM ~ months + age_bl + sex + educ + cdrsb_bl + apoe*months + causage_bl*months + (months  | RID), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.03b)
plot_model(fitlmer.03b, type = "pred", terms = c("age_c", "causage_bl"))

fitlmer.03c <- lmer(PHC_MEM ~ months + age_bl + sex + educ + cdrsb_bl + apoe*months + z_tl_bl*months + causage_bl*months + (months  | RID), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.03c)
plot_model(fitlmer.03c, type = "pred", terms = c("age_c", "z_tl_bl"))
plot_model(fitlmer.03c, type = "pred", terms = c("age_c", "causage_bl"))

## Interaction
fitlmer.04 <- lmer(PHC_MEM ~ months + age_bl + sex + educ + cdrsb_bl + apoe*months + z_tl_bl*causage_bl*months + neutrophil + nk_cell + b_cell + cd4_t_cell + cd8_t_cell +  (months  | RID), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.04)

## APOE Interaction
fitlmer.05a <- lmer(PHC_MEM ~ months + age_bl + sex + educ + cdrsb_bl +  z_tl_bl*apoe*months + (months  | RID), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.05a)

fitlmer.05b <- lmer(PHC_MEM ~ months + age_bl + sex + educ + cdrsb_bl +  z_tl_bl + causage_bl*apoe*months + (months  | RID), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.05b)

model_parameters(fitlmer.03, pretty_names = FALSE)
broom.mixed::tidy(fitlmer.03)

fitlmer.04 <- lmer(PHC_MEM ~ months + age_bl + sex + educ + causage_bl*apoe*months + (age_c  | RID), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.04)


fitlmer.05 <- lmer(
  PHC_MEM ~ months + age_bl + sex + educ + apoe * age_c + 
    TL_BP_ADJ * age_c + CausAge * age_c + 
    (1 + age_c + | RID), 
  REML = FALSE, 
  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), 
  data = adni
)

summary(fitlmer.05)
```

```{r}
all %>%
  filter(str_detect(BioAge, "TL|CausAge")) %>%
  select(outcome, BioAge, predictors, dataf) %>%
  unnest(dataf) %>%
  filter(str_detect(term, "tl|causage")) %>%
  filter(!str_detect(term, "raa|aaa|iraa")) %>%
  mutate(
    estimate = round(estimate, 3), 
    conf.low = signif(conf.low, 3),
    conf.high = signif(conf.high, 3),
    p = ifelse(p.value < 0.0001, insight::format_p(p.value, digits = "scientific2"), round(p.value, 3)),
    out = glue("{estimate} [{conf.low}, {conf.high}], p = {p}"), 
    out = str_replace(out, "p = p = ", "p = ")
  ) %>%
  filter(p < 0.05) %>%
  select(outcome, BioAge, predictors, term, out) %>%
  group_split(outcome)
```

```{r}
plot_causage <- function(Model) {
  plot_model(Model, type = "pred", terms = c("months", "causage_bl")) +
    theme_bw() + 
    labs(color = "CausAge") + 
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 8), 
      legend.position = 'none', 
      plot.title = element_blank()
    )
}

plot_tl <- function(Model) {
  plot_model(Model, type = "pred", terms = c("months", "z_tl_bl")) +
    theme_bw() + 
    labs(color = "TL") + 
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 8), 
      legend.position = 'none',
      plot.title = element_blank()
    )
      
}

estp <- all %>%
  filter(str_detect(BioAge, "TL_CausAge"), !str_detect(BioAge, "AAA|RAA|IRAA")) %>%
  select(outcome, BioAge, predictors, res) %>%
  mutate(
    DNAm_p = map(res, plot_causage),
    TL_p = map(res, plot_tl)
  ) 
 
dnm_plots <- estp$DNAm_p  # Extract DNAm plots
tl_plots <- estp$TL_p  # Extract TL plots

get_legend <- function(myplot) {
  g <- ggplotGrob(myplot)
  legend <- g$grobs[[which(sapply(g$grobs, function(x) x$name) == "guide-box")]]
  return(legend)
}

# Function to extract legend from ggplot
get_legend <- function(myplot) {
  g <- ggplotGrob(myplot)
  legend <- g$grobs[[which(sapply(g$grobs, function(x) x$name) == "guide-box")]]
  return(legend)
}

dnam_p_legend <- get_legend(
  # create some space to the left of the legend
  estp$DNAm_p[[1]]  + 
    guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
)

# Extract a common legend (from the first DNAm plot)
common_legend <- get_legend(estp$DNAm_p[[1]])

# Remove individual legends from each plot
tl_plots <- lapply(tl_plots, function(p) p + theme(legend.position = "none"))
dnm_plots <- lapply(dnm_plots, function(p) p + theme(legend.position = "none"))



cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = tl_plots, ncol = 1)
dnam_p_legend

# Create a multi-panel grid with TL on the left and DNAm on the right
cowplot::plot_grid(
  cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = tl_plots, ncol = 1),  # Left column: TL plots
  cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = dnm_plots, ncol = 1),  # Right column: DNAm plots
  dnam_p_legend,  # Common legend below
  ncol = 2,  # Arrange plots in 2 columns (TL | DNAm)
  rel_widths = c(1, 1)  # Equal width for both columns
)
```
